newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo March dept store sales up 21.7 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo March dept store sales up 21.7 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Tokyo in March rose 21.7 percent from a year earlier to 271.8 billion yen, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Wednesday.
The sharp rise in March is due to robust sales by individual consumers and corporate clients ahead of a consumption tax increase on April 1, the association said in a statement.
The survey covered 30 outlets of 14 companies.
The consumption tax was raised to five percent on April 1 from three percent.
